meta.purpose: Proof-of-concept dataset for the values-based portfolio builder. Attach this file to the bottom of the build prompt as the initial data source the app reads from.
meta.coverage_note: Expanded proof-of-concept sample (100 companies) spanning 11 GICS-style sectors (Information Technology, Communication Services, Consumer Discretionary, Consumer Staples, Health Care, Financials, Energy, Utilities, Industrials, Materials, Real Estate). Deliberately includes companies across sin-stock categories (tobacco, alcohol, gambling, weapons/defense) so exclusion screens have real companies to filter out. Still not the full S&P 500 or a licensed universe -- see important_caveats.

data_confidence_legend.High: Objective, easily verifiable public fact (HQ location, sector, whether company sells tobacco/alcohol/etc.)
data_confidence_legend.Medium: Reasonably well-documented public reputation/record, but involves some judgment (e.g., known ESG controversies, labor relations history)
data_confidence_legend.Low: No standardized public data exists at the per-company level; this is a rough estimate or placeholder and should be replaced with a real data feed (e.g., MSCI ESG, Sustainalytics, AAOIFI/IdealRatings for halal screening) before this tool is used for real investment decisions

important_caveats: Performance figures (growth_potential, stability) are qualitative TIERS (High/Medium/Low), not precise return numbers. Exact 5-year returns, volatility, and dividend yield should be pulled from a live market data API before this goes to real clients, since these change daily and this file is a static snapshot.

Criteria 5-12 and 19-23 (labor practices, exec comp ratios, board independence, religious compliance, political donations, data privacy, country-of-operation concerns) do not have clean, standardized public data at this granularity for most companies. Fields for these are best-effort estimates flagged 'Low' confidence and should be treated as placeholders, not verified facts.
This dataset should be replaced or supplemented with a licensed ESG/values data provider before being used for actual client recommendations.
Not investment advice. For prototype/demo purposes only.
meta.schema_notes: Each company has: identity fields (ticker/name/sector/hq_country), objective screen flags (sin-stock booleans), qualitative ESG category ratings (Environmental/Social/Governance, each 1-5 scale where 5 = strong positive alignment, paired with a confidence level), and a qualitative performance tier used for the risk-profile matching step.
changelog_v2: Removed 'religious_compliance' field (was 'Low' confidence / not independently screened for all 40 companies -> no real signal). Corresponding survey question (halal/kosher/faith-based screening) removed from the questionnaire.
Removed 'data_privacy_reputation' field (previously only populated for 1 of 40 companies). Corresponding survey question (data privacy practices) removed from the questionnaire.

Added 'market_profile' (market_cap_usd_billions_est, market_cap_tier, beta_est) to support: (a) a new blue-chip-vs-emerging survey question, and (b) quantitative tie-breaking within Strong/Partial match tiers.
Added 'five_year_annualized_return_pct_est' to performance_tier to support quantitative tie-breaking alongside the existing qualitative growth/stability tiers.

Added 'financial_leverage' to support a new survey question (avoiding highly leveraged companies), replacing the removed 'avoiding interest-based financial products' question, which had no per-company data.
Added 'dividend_policy' to support a new survey question (income/dividend preference vs. growth reinvestment).

Added 'revenue_geography' to support a revised, dataset-supportable version of the 'country of operation' question (domestic vs. globally diversified revenue, rather than an unscreened list of countries of concern).

All new fields are illustrative/Medium-confidence estimates consistent with this file's existing proof-of-concept status -- see data_confidence_legend and important_caveats. They must be replaced with a live market-data feed before real client use.

Expanded dataset from 40 to 100 companies (v2.1) across 11 sectors, including additional gambling (DKNG, MGM) and defense (GD) exposure for exclusion-screen testing. All new entries follow the same v2 schema (market_profile, financial_leverage, dividend_policy, revenue_geography) and the same illustrative/Medium-confidence conventions as the original 40.

Added financial_metrics block to every company (P/E, PEG, revenue growth YoY, profit margin, ROE, FCF margin, analyst consensus + price-target upside, 6-month/1-year return alongside the existing 5-year estimate) to support professional-grade financial scoring and the time-horizon-aware return selection described in Patch v6.

Added overall_financial_score (0-100) and overall_financial_score_label (Strong/Good/Fair/Weak) to financial_metrics for every company -- a fixed, dataset-wide composite score (not recomputed per client run) intended for client-facing display in the financial summary dropdown. See Patch v9.
